title: Do you need to EAT MORE to build muscle? 🍽️
caption:
Most people grow best in a small surplus. A bigger one mostly adds fat. Aim for about 0.25-0.5% of body weight a week. Bulking or not? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 7
first_comment: Bulk, cut or recomp right now? 🍽️
sources: Iraki J et al. Nutrition recommendations for bodybuilders in the off-season: a narrative review. Sports 2019;7:154 (small surplus; 0.25-0.5% body weight a week)
Garthe I et al. Effect of nutritional intervention on body composition and performance in elite athletes. Eur J Sport Sci 2013;13:295-303 (larger surplus: more fat gain)
Barakat C et al. Body recomposition: can trained individuals build muscle and lose fat at the same time? Strength Cond J 2020;42:7-21
